name: New Hampshire
agency: New Hampshire Department of Safety, Division of Motor Vehicles (NH DMV)
permitAge: No learner's permit is issued. Supervised practice from 15 and a half, carrying proof of age, with a licensed adult 25 or older in the front seat (NH DMV)

teen.supervisedHours: 40 hours logged with a parent, guardian or responsible adult, at least 10 at night, in addition to driver education (NH DMV)
teen.nightLimit: Youth Operator License: no driving 1 a.m. to 4 a.m. (RSA 263:14)
teen.passengerLimit: First 6 months of a Youth Operator License: no more than one non-family passenger under 25 unless a licensed responsible adult 25 or older is along; never more occupants than seat belts (RSA 263:14)
teen.phone: All drivers: no hand-held mobile device while driving or stopped in traffic; hands-free allowed. Under 18: no mobile device at all, hands-free included, except to report an emergency (RSA 265:79-c). Fines $100 / $250 / $500 within 24 months.

notes: Knowledge tests require 80 percent; administrative rule Saf-C 1000 says up to 50 multiple-choice questions and up to 60 minutes. Commercial sites say 40 questions. Number of questions left null.
Knowledge tests listed in English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Mandarin, Portuguese, Farsi and ASL (NH DMV testing page). A 2025 bill (HB 901) proposed English-only exams; its status was not confirmed.
Youth Operator License: issued over 16 and under 21, expires on the 21st birthday. RSA 263:14 says some youth restrictions do not apply over 18; which ones not confirmed.
Driver education required under 18. Night for logged hours: half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise.
Seat belts: drivers under 18 must be belted; drivers may not carry an unbelted passenger under 18 (RSA 265:107-a).

Move Over (RSA 265:37-a, 'Sherrill's Law'): slow down and move over when safe for any stopped vehicle with warning signals (hazard lights, flares, cones, caution signs). Fine amounts differ between sources; not used.
Research limited to web-search summaries; official pages could not be fetched (proxy 403).
